title: Leagues, chests and badges
changes: New League tab: your player card with a level ring, weekly leagues (top 7 move up), friends by code with a 👏 cheer, and class groups. Other students only ever see your first name and an emoji, and there's no chat.
Three quests every day. Finish all three to open a bonus chest worth 20 to 35 XP.
14 badges to collect, from First steps to Legend. Locked ones show how close you are.
Confetti when you level up, earn a badge, hit a streak milestone or finish your quests.
Papers are simpler: Guess Paper, real past papers by board, and a practice test where you pick the chapters and the length.
Sign-up is 3 short steps, and Home shows one clear "Do this now".
Profile shows how much of this month's Ustaad time you've used.
Parhlou Plus: more Ask Ustaad, AI marking and no ads.
Safer and faster: secure sign-in links, an encrypted login on your phone, and fixes for older Android phones.
yourRequests: Friends, leagues and streaks like Duolingo
More interactive and gamified
A simpler papers section
A $3 monthly AI limit per student
Free and paid plans, with Pakistani payments
A full security and legal check

title: Calmer, simpler, and your own Ustaad
changes: Home is now your journey: Ustaad's face, your streak and goal, today's session, and one card per subject showing how much is done, the marks you're heading for, your strong and weak topics, and what to do now.
Ustaad has a new face. He's happy when your streak is going, and sad, then a little cross, when it breaks. He's the app icon too.
The Books tab holds every subject. Each book has its own path, units and solutions.
Tap 📅 Calendar on Home to see a month of study: tap any day to see what you did and when.
Ask Ustaad is simpler: four big starts (snap a question, explain a topic, make me a paper, quiz me). Answers show the result first, and the steps open on a tap.
Ask Ustaad for a paper or notes, e.g. "make me a paper on Unit 2" or "exercise 3.2 with answers", and he makes the PDF for you to print or share.
Papers in one place: board papers, then make a paper for an exercise, a chapter, half the book or the full book. Papers follow the board exam's pattern and the questions that come most often.
Your phone goes on Do Not Disturb during a paper (if you allow it) and goes back to normal when you hand in.
Profile shows what you can still do with Ustaad this month, like "about 840 questions". Unused time carries over for 4 months.
Send feedback from Profile; it goes straight to the Parhlou team.
Ustaad remembers you: how you like to learn, your goals and what you find hard. He keeps you on your studies and won't help with anything harmful.
The whole Class 9 Maths course was checked again against the textbook, question by question: 388 corrections, 3 missing MCQs added, and no leftover notes in questions.

Realistic Ustaad face as the app icon, happy or sad with the streak
Remove My book and Scan from Home; Ustaad makes PDFs
Make my paper by chapter, exercise, half or full
Do Not Disturb during papers
Feedback to the owner
Owner can view a student's portfolio
Path vs Book
Calendar pops up
Simpler papers and Ask Ustaad, fewer words
Monthly allowance that carries over
Ustaad remembers each student
Lively but focused
Student profile and mindset
Off-topic and unsafe talk handled
Exam-focused mock papers
Audit the complete Class 9 Maths content

title: A brand-new look, sounds, and drawings from Ustaad
changes: A fresh Parhlou look: bold teal and sunny yellow, a friendly rounded font, and big 3D buttons and cards that press down when you tap them.
Sounds! Taps, picking an answer, right and wrong, combos, finishing a lesson, your streak and levelling up all have their own sound. Turn them off any time in Profile → Sounds.
Lessons feel like a game: a springy progress bar, a wrong answer shakes, a combo pops up after 3 in a row, and your XP counts up at the end.
Your path has a colour for every unit, and the tab bar bounces to show where you are.
Typing an answer? The box is ready as soon as the question appears, and Done on your keyboard checks it.
Ustaad can now draw: graphs, shaded regions for inequalities, number lines, coordinates, triangles and shapes, Venn diagrams, bar and pie charts and tables, drawn exactly from the numbers.

Ustaad finds YouTube lessons only when you ask to understand a topic. When you ask it to solve something, you get the answer and steps straight away, with a "Watch a lesson on this topic" button if you want one.
yourRequests: "UI not uniform … Duolingo vibes … animations … interactive sounds … not interactive … doesn't retain focus" → new look, 3D buttons, animations, original sounds, focus on answer boxes.
"YouTube videos only when the student asks about a concept" → videos for explain/what-is questions only; a button for the rest.
"It is not able to make illustrations, graphs, diagrams" → Ustaad draws graphs, diagrams, charts and tables.

title: Real past papers, printed papers and an AI examiner
changes: Practice now comes from real Punjab board past papers: MCQs, short and long questions from Class 9 papers (2018–2024) across every board. Each one shows where it came: "📋 Came in Lahore 2023 (Group I)".
Only topics that are in your new book and the 2027 syllabus are kept. Sets, trigonometry and statistics come from board papers too. The most repeated questions come first.
Every paper gives you 3 tries. You'll see "Attempt 2 of 3 · best so far 72%". After the 3rd try the paper locks and keeps your best score.
Make my paper: Ustaad picks a full 75-mark paper in the 2027 board pattern for you, from real board questions, with more from your weak topics.

Print any paper: a board-style PDF with roll number boxes, a bubble sheet for the MCQs and the board's numbering (Q2 (iii), Q5 (b)). Share it to a printer or a print shop. Parents can print the marking scheme too.

Write it on paper like the real exam, in any order. Scan your pages and Ustaad reads your handwriting, finds "2 iii)" and "5 b)", follows answers onto the next page and ignores what you crossed out. You check what it read before marking.
Marked like the board: two AI examiners mark every step separately; if they disagree, a head examiner decides. You see which line earned each mark and what was missing.

Examiner's analysis after every paper: marks by unit and question type, where your marks went (missing steps, final answers, unattempted parts, MCQs), your strong topics, the topics that need hard work with what went wrong and what to do, a 7-day plan and exam-technique advice. Serious, honest and still friendly; it's in the marked PDF too.
yourRequests: "All practice questions and paper should be made from past paper" → practice, unit tests and papers use real board questions first, tagged with board and year.
"3 tries should be given per each paper" → 3 attempts per paper, then locked with your best score.
"Questions should be picked by AI and made into PDF … board style … printed" → Make my paper, and a printable board-style PDF for every paper.
"AI invigilator should check handwriting … students write 2b) … mark like board examiners" → scan in any order, handwriting read by label, double-marked step by step.

"Examiner should tell weak topics and give complete analysis like a tutor, serious but friendly" → Examiner's analysis on every result, with a plan and a button to work on each weak topic with Ustaad.

title: Ask Ustaad: your personal tutor, now with photo questions
changes: The AI tutor is now Ask Ustaad. Chat like ChatGPT: ask follow-ups like "why?", "explain step 3 again" or "give me a harder one", and Ustaad remembers the conversation.

Snap a question: take a photo or pick one from your gallery (book, guess paper or school test). Ustaad reads it and answers like a perfect exam answer: numbered steps, each with a "Why?", the final answer, the idea behind the topic, an exam tip and a quick check.
If it's a question from your textbook, Ustaad teaches from the app's checked solution, shows the book's figure and answer, and links to the full solution.
Watch a lesson: every answer offers YouTube lessons on that topic.
Ustaad knows you: your weak and strong topics, your exam date and your target marks shape every answer. Choose English, Urdu, or English with Urdu explanations in Profile → My Ustaad.
Your chats are saved on your phone. Open them again from "Chats", or start a new one.
Ask Ustaad stays locked while you're sitting a timed paper.
yourRequests: "AI chat bot name is Ask Ustaad" → renamed everywhere.
"Upload image of questions, answer in real answer steps with explanation" → photo questions with step-by-step answer cards.
"ChatGPT style discussion with complete topic understanding" → real conversation, topic explanations, follow-up suggestions.
"Find relative videos from YouTube" → lesson videos with every answer.
"Student avatar that answers according to that student" → My Ustaad: Ustaad adapts to your level, mistakes, language and goals.

title: Real book diagrams, proper maths, reminders and your progress
changes: Every diagram from your textbook is now in the app: triangles, Venn diagrams, graphs, number lines and constructions (303 figures). 181 questions show their figure, and 75 show the book's answer figure under "Book answer".
Maths looks like your book: stacked fractions, square roots with a bar, and powers written small and raised (x², 10⁻³).
Daily reminder from Ustad at the time you choose (Profile → Daily reminder; 6 pm unless you change it). It only comes on days you haven't studied yet.
Exam countdown on Home: about how many days until your 2027 board exam.
Tap your streak or XP on Home to see your progress: this week's XP chart, your level and your badges.
Under each solution: "Similar questions" from the same exercise, and "Was this helpful?" so we can keep improving answers.
Phones with less memory get a lighter look for the bottom bar, so the app stays smooth.
yourRequests: "What do you think is missing" → round 1 of the plan: diagrams, maths layout, reminders, countdown, progress and badges, similar questions, feedback, speed on low-end phones.

title: Board-style marking, real exam timing and no dead buttons
changes: Board papers now run like the exam hall: the MCQ part has its own 20 minutes and is collected when time ends (or when you hand it in), then the subjective part opens.
Your marked paper shows your grade (A+, A, B, C, D, E or F; pass at 33%) and the examiner's remarks: exactly where you lost marks and how to get them next time.
Every marking point still shows a tick or a cross with what was missing, why it matters and how to earn it.
Mistakes from guided sessions now also count towards your weak topics, so the plan repairs them.
Home's "My book" and "Papers" shortcuts now switch tabs properly (before, they could leave the Book tab unresponsive).
Mock papers that can't be built yet are shown as information instead of cards that look tappable but do nothing.
A new automatic check taps every button on every main screen and fails the build if any of them does nothing.
yourRequests: "Real board like marking assessment" → two-part board timing, grade band and examiner's remarks.
"App is not interactive / should be responsive" → dead buttons found and fixed; a test now guards every button.

title: Learn like a game: guided sessions, streaks and your tutor Ustad
changes: Meet Ustad, your personal tutor. He greets you, tells you what to practise today and cheers you on.
Start today's session from Home: one question at a time, a big Check button, and an instant green or red answer with the reason.
Six kinds of practice: multiple choice, true or false, type your answer, put the solution steps in order, pick the next step, and definition flashcards.
Questions you miss come back at the end of the session until you get them right, and they also feed your weak topics.
XP, a daily goal, a day streak (with a streak freeze every 7 days), levels and badges. Haptics and sounds on every answer (sound can be muted).
Your path: each section of the current unit is a step that fills up as you master it. Tap "All units" to see the whole book.
Busy day? A 5-minute session keeps your streak alive.
Celebration screen with confetti, your XP, accuracy and best combo.
yourRequests: "Duolingo like experience and guided study" → Today's session, the path, XP, streaks and goals.
"Personal tutor feel" → Ustad on Home and in every session, plus "Ask Ustad" on every answer.
"App is not interactive" → every answer gets instant feedback, animations, haptics and sound.

title: Full Class 9 Maths course, exam kits and board papers
changes: Step-by-step solutions for every example and exercise question in all 13 units (1,206 questions). Find any question from Home → Solutions, by unit and exercise or by searching "2.3 Q4".
Every answer is checked against the textbook's answer key. Where the key itself is wrong, you see the right working and a note. A "Book answer" line shows the key's answer.
Every step has a "Why?" that explains the rule behind it, like a tutor sitting next to you.

Exam kit for each unit: definitions to learn word for word, formula sheet, most important questions, likely short questions, how to write for full marks and mistakes that lose marks. Open it from Book → a unit → Exam kit.
Annual Exam 2027 smart syllabus: content the board leaves out is marked "Not in this year's exam · practice", and your plan, tests and papers skip it. Unit 8 (Logic) is not examined in 2027.
Three full board papers (75 marks, 2 h 30 min) laid out exactly like the 2027 paper: 15 MCQs, Q2–Q4 (6 of 9 each), Q5–Q7 (2 of 3), Q8–Q9 (1 of 2).
Unit tests for every unit, including graphs (Unit 5, 10) and constructions (Unit 11): draw on paper and photograph your work.
The app now updates itself: it checks for new builds on every launch and every 6 hours, downloads them in the background and tells you when an update is ready to install with one tap.
This "What's new" page opens after every update, and is always in Profile → What's new.

"Find keys for this book and align answer with each problem" → every answer aligned with the textbook key and an independent check.
"Every single thing from book to be covered" → completeness audit: every example and question in the book is in the app.
"Teach them to ace 100/100" → exam kits and board papers on the official 2027 pattern.
